title: R.A.D.S. Core Data Schemas
description: Collection of JSON Schema definitions for the Pack 1 runtime.

SourceModality.description: Enumerated input modalities.  Only 'text' is allowed in Pack 1.

ConsentStatus.description: Possible consent statuses.  Used across turns and relationship events.

RelationshipScope.description: Possible scopes for a relationship (e.g. personal or professional).

Turn.description: A single exchange within a session.  Immutable once written.

session_id.description: Identifier of the session this turn belongs to.

episode_id.description: Optional episode identifier if this turn is part of a bounded episode.

timestamp.description: Time the turn was recorded in ISO 8601 format.

source_modality.description: Modality of the input.  See SourceModality definition.

speaker_id.description: Identifier of the speaking agent (may be a system role or an external party).

content.description: Raw textual content of the turn.

co_present_entities.description: Other participant identifiers present during the turn.  Future‑safe hook; empty in Pack 1.

consent_status.description: Consent status for storing or analysing this turn.  Null indicates unspecified.

Episode.description: A bounded collection of turns grouped under OR‑gate logic.

start_turn_id.description: Identifier of the first turn in the episode.

end_turn_id.description: Identifier of the final turn in the episode; null until episode concludes.

turn_ids.description: Ordered list of turns contained in the episode.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the episode was created.

Note.description: An extracted observation or summary derived from one or more turns.

turn_id.description: Identifier of the turn this note was derived from.

content.description: Body of the note in free text.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the note was created.

version_of.description: If this note supersedes an earlier note, this holds the previous note’s id.

status.description: Version status of the note for versioning and contradiction handling.

evidence_ids.description: Identifiers of related notes or turns providing evidence for this note.

NoteLink.description: Represents a relationship between two notes or between a note and a turn.

from_id.description: Identifier of the origin note or turn.

to_id.description: Identifier of the target note or turn.

relation_type.description: The semantic relation connecting the two entities.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the link was created.

StateSnapshot.description: Captures the full deterministic state at a moment in the session.

snapshot_id.description: Unique identifier for the state snapshot.

session_id.description: Identifier of the session for which this snapshot was taken.

state.description: Opaque deterministic state representation to be interpreted by the state engine.

note_ids.description: Identifiers of notes relevant to this snapshot.

Session.description: Represents an ongoing interaction session between a person and the system.

person_id.description: Identifier of the person this session is associated with.

end_time.description: When the session ended; null if ongoing.

episode_ids.description: Episodes that belong to this session.

active.description: Whether the session is currently active.

SpeakerProfile.description: Metadata about a speaker within a conversation.  May map to a PersonProfile if identity is recognised.

person_id.description: Reference to the associated PersonProfile when identity recognition is available.

confidence.description: Confidence that the speaker has been matched to a person.

PersonProfile.description: Persistent record for an individual person in the system.

RelationshipEvent.description: Captures an interaction or relationship state change between two persons.

relationship_scope.description: Scope of the relationship.  See RelationshipScope definition.

event_type.description: Categorisation of the event (e.g. meeting, call, gift).

source_modality.description: Modality of the interaction giving rise to the event.  See SourceModality definition.

co_present_entities.description: Identifiers for other entities present during the event.

consent_status.description: Recorded consent status for capturing this relationship event.  Null indicates unspecified.

metadata.description: Extensible key–value data for future relationship policy engines.
